lastCompletedStory.title: Add merge-watch-poll-error event vocabulary and consecutiveNullPolls state persistence

nextStoryContext: US-002 wires the actual behavior: change GhPollFn's return type to a discriminated result (PrStatus on success, an error result carrying gh stderr on failure -- no more bare null), increment MergeWatchState.consecutiveNullPolls on each error result (reset to 0 on the next successful poll), and emit the new 'merge-watch-poll-error' event (kind added in US-001) via logEvent at the configured threshold N, edge-triggered (once per crossing, not every tick past threshold). Use the exact interfaces added in US-001: MergeWatchPollErrorEventDetail { prNumber, consecutiveNullPolls, lastStderr } and MergeWatchState.consecutiveNullPolls?: number (mirrors pollCount/updateBranchCount: optional, absent=0, always written by writeMergeWatchState). Also thread an orchestrator narration carrying the gh stderr per the story description. docs/recovery-runbook.md section (t) lists merge-watch event kinds narratively but is not exhaustive (merge-watch-stalled from CAM-182 is already absent from it); update that section's event-kind list only if the story's acceptance criteria require doc changes -- US-001 did not.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-001 is a pure internal TS/JSON vocabulary + state-persistence addition (event kind union, detail interface, optional state field); no external library API surface was exercised. The PRD's own officialDocsConsulted entry (gh pr view --json) covers the GhPollFn discriminated-result work that US-002 will implement.
